definition: Observed attributed player opportunities only. Source regular-season pass/run plays with nonmissing EPA; targets require receiver ID, carries require rusher ID. Shares divide by sum of attributed counts in selected team weeks, not every team snap. Missing player-week rows are not proven inactive/zero opportunity. Not an injury effect, future forecast or redistributive allocation.

attribution.creator: Contributors
attribution.changes: Filtered and aggregated existing stored 2026 team/player-week observations; no raw plays in this output.
